description: Letter from Georgia O'Keeffe to Anita O'Keeffe Young requesting Anita write a check to artist Marilynn Thuma (Mym Tuma). Includes half page previously stapled to first page of letter, presumably written by Thuma, containing request for cashier's cheque.
maker: O'Keeffe, Georgia, 1887-1986, Tuma, Mym (Marilynn Thuma), b. 1940
title: Georgia O'Keeffe to Anita O'Keeffe Young
